entries.subject: Pharaoh
entries.object: himself in the land and made its people into factions

spans.text: [4] AR: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًۭا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ EN: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive.

entries.description: We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers

spans.text: Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."

entries.description: of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief
entries.subject: of Pharaoh
entries.object: him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief

spans.text: [8] AR: فَٱلْتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّۭا وَحَزَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰطِـِٔينَ EN: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief.

entries.task_id: he|will|be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you
entries.description: He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you
entries.subject: He
entries.object: be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you

spans.text: [9] AR: وَقَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍۢ لِّى وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ EN: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you.

entries.description: And she said to his sister
entries.subject: And she

spans.text: [11] AR: وَقَالَتْ لِأُخْتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِ ۖ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ EN: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.

entries.task_id: household that|will|be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
entries.description: household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
entries.subject: household that
entries.object: be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"

spans.text: [12] AR: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَٰصِحُونَ EN: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"

[13] AR: فَرَدَدْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true.

entries.description: so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him
entries.subject: so Moses

spans.text: And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him.

entries.description: This is from the work of Satan
entries.subject: This

spans.text: [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan.
Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."
Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

entries.task_id: i|will|never be an assistant to the criminals
entries.description: I will never be an assistant to the criminals
entries.subject: I
entries.object: never be an assistant to the criminals

spans.text: [17] AR: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًۭا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ EN: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."
Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."

entries.task_id: my lord|will|guide me to the sound way
entries.description: my Lord will guide me to the sound way
entries.subject: my Lord
entries.object: guide me to the sound way

spans.text: [22] AR: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَآءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِى سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ EN: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."
He said, "What is your circumstance?"

entries.description: our father is an old man
entries.subject: our father

spans.text: They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."
